profileLabel: Center-left economics (low confidence); social values balanced (low confidence)
summary: Bukidnon 3rd District representative with 184 principal-authored bills. Authored a lupus health program, a Philippine Center for Disease Prevention and Control, comprehensive maternal healthcare, tobacco sale regulation, sugar warning labels, a full ban on online gambling, crisis centers for women and children, technology-facilitated violence against women, and revisions to Revised Penal Code provisions on marriage and exceptional circumstances.
caveat: Penal code amendments (HB02931, HB05936) were read from titles only. Social score nets progressive gender bills against a gambling ban and is sensitive to that framing.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a national lupus program, a disease prevention center and comprehensive maternal healthcare (-2); tobacco sale regulation and sugar warning labels (-1). Travel-tax abolition neutral. Two issues, bill-based.

sources.text: House member page, authored bills: HB04591, HB05115, HB05113, HB00231, HB11749 (retrieved 2026-11-01)

social.label: Mixed / moderate
social.rationale: Authored gender-violence and penal-code reforms favoring victims (+2) offset by a complete ban on online gambling and gambling promotion (-2). Two issues; offsetting signals.
